acquisition method: each FT MS1 survey scan was analyzed at 60,000 resolving power in profile mode, followed by rapid IT MS2 scans on the top 15 ions with monoisotopic peak selection
alkylation reagent: alkylated in the dark (ambient temperature, 30 min) with iodoacetamide (9 mM)
alkylation concentration: alkylated in the dark (ambient temperature, 30 min) with iodoacetamide (9 mM)
cleavage agent: Proteins were digested on-filter (16 h, 37 °C) with sequencing-grade modified trypsin (50:1, Promega)
fractionation method: we performed high-pH/low–pH two-dimensional reversed-phase chromatography to separate peptide samples prior to MS/MS
instrument: High-resolution tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) was performed on a single LTQ Orbitrap Elite instrument (Thermo Scientific)
ionization type: coupled on-line to the nano-UPLC system through a Thermo EasySpray interface
reduction reagent: the samples were reduced (70 °C, 5 min) with dithiothreitol (3 mM)
reduction concentration: the samples were reduced (70 °C, 5 min) with dithiothreitol (3 mM)
